status: Completed; signed ARM64 APK assembled and verified
changes: Audio/video attachments opened from Messages, Groups, Gallery and Files automatically start once prepared, foregrounded and attached to a video surface. Pauses, backgrounding, audio-focus loss, close and retry remain lifecycle owned.

Playable YouTube URLs are replaced in the message display by a thumbnail and Play Video button. Both the thumbnail and button use the existing internal signed YouTube handoff, preserving the start timestamp. Original message text remains intact for copy/search. Other/unrepresented links remain visible.
YouTube previews default on; explicit Privacy off remains respected, and unavailable thumbnails retain a clickable play placeholder.

Explicit YouTube handoffs arm a bounded one-shot autoplay request in the native host. Playback no longer requires an extra WebView gesture. Wrong-video/expired requests are discarded and a later pause is preserved.

Video screens temporarily enable sensor rotation. Landscape hides app chrome and system bars and removes safe-inset padding; portrait restores controls. Exit restores prior orientation/bar/window settings.

YouTube landscape uses an immersive video viewport, avoiding gesture-gated requestFullscreen. Native custom fullscreen also hides system bars and safely clears its callback before notifying Chromium. Attachment controls are hidden in landscape until tapped.

checks.javascript: Exact production scripts passed autoplay, stale/expired intent, pause/cleanup, landscape/portrait restoration and prior ad/metadata scenarios
checks.apk: Original signing identity, native16KiB alignment and current SDK/native source provenance verified

limits: Actual Samsung/YouTube audible playback, streaming/autoplay restrictions and physical rotation remain unverified; public provider markup can change.
